remarks: SOPHISTICATED CONTEMPORARY RETREAT - CLOVER LANE Exciting opportunity to own a beautifully reimagined Contemporary home on an expansive 1.27 acres at the end of a peaceful Westport cul-de-sac. This thoughtfully renovated 3000 square-foot residence features open concept living areas with streaming natural light and captivating views of mature lush greenery.  A sleek, designer kitchen serves as the heart of the home with contemporary cabinetry, premium countertops, and curated finishes. Seamless indoor-outdoor flow creates an ideal environment for both intimate gatherings and group entertaining.  Highlights include: * Dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows framing natural beauty * Soaring ceilings enhancing spaciousness * Thoughtfully renovated bathrooms with modern fixtures * Multiple access points to outdoor terraces and patios * Clean architectural lines celebrating mid-century heritage with contemporary sophistication *  The generous, private grounds offer endless possibilities while recent updates ensure modern comfort and efficiency. City water, Natural Gas and City Sewer complete this unique residence.  Enjoy tranquil living surrounded by nature's beauty with ultimate privacy, plus prime location minutes from Westport's beaches, top schools, vibrant downtown, and Metro North train service.  A rare opportunity to embrace sophisticated contemporary living on substantial acreage in coveted Westport.
